title: Community Health Worker
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION (evaluate-program skill). Subject is the PROGRAM (Foothill College x TOP 126100), not a job title. Destination SOCs DERIVED: crosswalk(126100) intersected with SECTORS['health'].socs minus ALL_OTHER/PROMOTION/EXPERIENCE_5YR = ['21-1094']. Dropped: 11-9111, 21-1091, 25-1071, 99-9999. Peer set = top 6 Bay colleges by 5-year awards on THIS TOP (a program evaluation's peers must share the TOP; the role report mixed TOPs). live_postings and competencies reused verbatim from the matching role report (same SOCs, already verified). EVIDENCE-FORWARD, NO VERDICT.
lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's Community Health Worker program (TOP 126100). It covers regional occupational demand targeted by the program, and the program's award and enrollment trends in the context of other colleges offering the same program in the region.
demand_note: Foothill's Community Health Worker program leads to SOC 21-1094 via the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), this occupation demands roughly 320 openings a year, at a median salary of $70,860.
alignment_note: The set of colleges offering TOP 126100 in the Bay Area. All of these colleges support SOC 21-1094 via the same TOP code through the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.
award_note: Award trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.
enrollment_note: Enrollment trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.

21-1094.title: SLH Care Management Community Health Worker

21-1094.description: Promotes health within a community by helping residents adopt healthy behaviors and advocating for their needs with healthcare providers and social service agencies.
